cost.notes: Fall 2026-Spring 2027 from Emerson's tuition page: full-time tuition (12-16 credits) $30,080 per term, $60,160 for the year; undergraduate student services fee $550 per term ($1,100 a year); food and housing, Boston double room $22,464 a year (single $22,984, triple $21,944). Health insurance is billed separately ($3,029 fall, $1,769 spring) and tuition insurance is $104 per term. Estimated indirect costs on the page: books and supplies $1,256, miscellaneous $1,852, travel $820 in-state or $1,460 out-of-state, off-campus living $19,584. The page gives no total cost of attendance, so none is shown. Emerson's international aid page lists only merit scholarships, private scholarships and private loans; the application page tells only U.S. citizens and permanent residents to submit financial aid materials.

stats.notes: No CDS found: Emerson's Institutional Research page (emerson.edu/departments/institutional-research) answered only a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' check, and no Emerson Common Data Set turned up in searches, so these figures are IPEDS fall 2024 as printed on College Navigator: 10,378 applicants (3,040 men, 7,317 women), 51% admitted, 16% of admitted students enrolled. College Navigator prints the admit and yield rates only; the exact counts are the IPEDS fall 2024 ADM file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal (all-sex row): 10,378 applied, 5,325 admitted (51.3%), 828 enrolled (15.5% of admitted), which agree with the 51% and 16% on College Navigator. Residency, international, waitlist, early-decision and GPA data are CDS items and are not added. SAT/ACT percentiles cover only the 16% (130 students) who submitted the SAT and 5% (45) who submitted the ACT; College Navigator gives no SAT total. Undergraduate enrollment is 3,908 (fall 2024); the nonresident count (583) is the IPEDS fall 2024 'nonresident alien' undergraduate total from the Urban Institute portal (14.9% of 3,908; College Navigator's chart shows 'U.S. Nonresident: 15%'). Emerson is test optional.
